items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I ask Ingrid Bergman if she can still hum the tune like she did in the movie, and she starts humming 'As Time Goes By,' and then I start playing it on the piano, and in the door walks unannounced and a complete surprise to Ingrid Bergman -- Frank Sinatra singing the song

ctx.x: Yes, Boston. And let's see, I've been doing a few outside things beside the Plaza bar, let me see, after Colorado Springs, I went to Cleveland, in October -- there was a date in Cleveland, and my two boys Theodore played bass with me, and Steven played drums, but a private jazz party, it was at the Madda Mansion, put on by a man named Ridley Watts who's quite a sponsor of jazz in Cleveland, ad has these special jazz parties, very similar to Dick Gibson's parties in Colorado Springs.
And I think that's about the -- oh, and I went out to Hollywood late in November to work on the tribute to Ingrid Bergman.
